svg.title: Race R1: the 251 hard games at the known score against the work
svg.desc: The share of the 251 hard games of 3441-5060 at the known score within W work, one step line an arm, with a marker at the budget of each effort level; the tables of the entry give the numbers.
svg.text: Race R1: the 251 hard games at the known score against the work
Share of the games at the known score within W work (steps and 32 for each neighborhood); the axis starts at 30%.
A marker is the share at the budget of an effort level: E1 is 65,536 work, and each level is twice the one below.
Seeded from the proven game of n - 1; one seed, 4 threads.
Labeled at the right: the default and the three arms with the highest mean share over E1 to E7.
work (log axis); effort level above it
